thief.guide.title: Thief Guide
thief.guide.recipe.drop: Dropped by a magician, or given for one brought in alive
thief.guide.people.1.t:
Comes by night to rob you.
It takes: 3 stacks from a chest or barrel (up to 16 of each), and ripe crops (up to 8, replanted). Then it shines for 20 seconds and runs.
It fears: you within 7 blocks; wolves and dogs (tamed ones too) within 12; an iron door stops it; a bell by the chest limits it to 1 stack.
Deal with it: tie it with the rope (use it on it); no need to fight.
thief.guide.people.2.t:
The member of a crew that steals. It flees as fast as you walk (4.3 blocks/s); sprint to catch it.
When you close in, it gives all it has stolen to a mate and keeps shining as a decoy. The one that has the loot is the one it was passed to: look at what it holds, or use the tracker.
When a mate is caught, it comes to cut the rope.
thief.guide.people.3.t:
It does not steal; it stays within 12 blocks of its mates, a spyglass in hand.
Within 24 blocks of you it whistles: the whole crew draws back for 10 seconds and drops what it was doing.
Deal with it first, and the crew will not pull out early.
thief.guide.people.4.t:
10 to 20 seconds after a crew member is caught, one of the others comes out holding up a sign, shining; the chat tells you where.
It offers: let your captive go, and 70% of the loot they carry comes back. The offer stands 60 seconds, and no one tries to rescue meanwhile.
To accept: let it go, empty-handed, not sneaking. A blow to it ends the talk.
thief.guide.people.5.t:
A crew of three or more has one 40% of the time. It does not steal; 40 health, a purple boss bar.
Within 24 blocks of you it makes copies every 20 seconds (up to 3), then swaps places with one.
The rope will not hold it until it is worn down to a third of its health. Hung, or tied to a tree or rack, it slips free sooner the longer it is there; not in your hand.
Drops: a badge and 3 emeralds. Alive at the board: 10 emeralds.

Its tricks:
· Reaching: every 30 s, a chest within 14 blocks, a stack a second, up to three, a line of sparks to the chest; a blow stops it. A bell makes it one.
· The swap: half the time a prop is left where a stack was, so the chest looks full; players near are told. Catch it and search it to get the real things back.
· Cards: every 6 s, one thrown at you if it sees you, 2 damage and a little slowness; a shield stops it.
· Smoke: every 16 s, a cloud at your feet within 10 blocks, blind and slow for 3 s, and it changes places meanwhile.
thief.guide.people.6.t:
A copy the magician makes looks exactly like it and lasts 10 seconds.
It turns to smoke on a touch: hit it, whip it, rope it (the rope is not used up).
The real one is the one that hurts and has the boss bar.
When the magician is tied, all its copies are gone.
thief.guide.people.7.t:
Use the rope on it: its hands are tied in front of it, a rope runs from your hand to its hands.
It stops running and stealing and follows you. Empty hand, not sneaking, lets it go; the rope comes back.
From here, lead it to the board for the bounty, or use the rope on a tree, the underside of a block or a rack for another way of tying.
thief.guide.people.8.t:
Leading a tied one, use the rope on the side of a log, fence, wall or pillar: it stands with its back to it, wound with rope, arms pulled back.
Resentment +1 a second. Only one person to a side.
thief.guide.people.9.t:
Leading a tied one, use the rope on the underside of a block: it is hung by its hands, a rope down to the wrists, feet off the ground. Needs 3 free blocks below.
Resentment +2 a second: shown off, it hates more. Break the block above and it falls free.
thief.guide.people.10.t:
Use the rope on the rack with a tied one in tow: it is spread out, a rope from each wrist and ankle to the four corners, feet off the ground.
Resentment +2 a second. Break any block of the rack and the whole frame falls; it is freed.
thief.guide.tools.1.t:
Craft: 6 string in a diagonal, gives 2.
Use it on a thief (or a zombie, villager or the like): its hands are tied, it stops running and stealing, and follows you.
Leading it, use the rope on: the side of a log, fence, wall or pillar (tied back to it), the underside of a block (hung), a rack (spread).
Empty hand, not sneaking, lets it go; the rope comes back. A magician has to be worn down first.
thief.guide.tools.2.t:
Craft: stick + 2 string + leather.
Anything it hits cracks and sparks. A tied one drops something, and neither a tied one nor a thief can be killed by it.
Lash a tied thief: 35% it tells where the other free thieves are, and they shine 30 seconds. Once each.
Each lash adds 12 to its resentment.
thief.guide.tools.3.t:
Craft: 4 logs, 2 sticks, 1 rope.
Use it on the ground: needs a flat place 3 wide and 3 high.
Use the rope on it with a tied one in tow: spread out, a rope to each of the four corners.
Break any block and the whole frame falls.
thief.guide.tools.4.t:
Craft: 3 planks on top; plank, paper, plank; a stick below. It stands as a 2×2 poster.
Lead a tied thief to it and use it: lone 3 emeralds, crew 5, magician 10 and a badge; experience, the rope back, any loot left.
Use it with a badge in hand: 8 emeralds. Empty-handed: the rules.
thief.guide.tools.5.t:
Craft: compass + spyglass.
In hand, it shows above the hotbar the direction arrow, the distance and the last place of the nearest thief that carries loot.
Use it for the same in chat.
When the thief passes the loot to a mate, it follows the loot.
thief.guide.tools.6.t:
A magician drops it, or you get one when you bring a magician alive to the board.
Use the board with it in hand: 8 emeralds, and one badge used up each time.
thief.guide.tools.7.t:
The ordinary bell. Within 5 blocks of a chest or crop it rings when it is robbed, players within 48 blocks are told, the thief shines half a minute and can only take 1 stack (2 crops).
The cheapest defence.
thief.guide.tools.8.t:
This book.
Craft: 1 book + 1 string. One comes with you the first time you enter a world.
Use it in hand to open it.
For another (operators):
{{/give @s thief:thief_guide}}
thief.guide.play.1.t:
Each dusk, each player has a 35% chance of a thief, sometimes a whole crew (25%).
It looks for chests, barrels and ripe crops nearby, then runs. It leaves trapped chests, shulker boxes and other mods' storage alone.
It does nothing unless a player is within 128 blocks; with mobGriefing off it steals nothing.
thief.guide.play.2.t:
· A bell within 5 blocks of a chest or crop: it rings when robbed, and the thief can only take 1 stack.
· An iron door stops it; a wooden one does not.
· It runs when you are within 7 blocks.
· It runs from wolves and dogs (wild or tamed) within 12 blocks, the magician too. Keep a few dogs about the house.
· One that has stolen shines for 20 seconds, and a crew passes the loot to a mate when chased.
thief.guide.play.3.t:
Use the rope: it stops running and stealing, and follows you.
Leading it, use the rope again on: the side of a log, fence, wall or pillar; the underside of a block; a rack.
Empty hand, not sneaking, lets it go; sneaking is searching.
Only one person to a side.
thief.guide.play.4.t:
Sneak + use on a tied one: you find one thing at a time.
Lash a tied thief with the whip: something drops, it cannot be killed; 35% it tells where the other free thieves are, and they shine 30 seconds. Once each.
thief.guide.play.5.t:
The longer tied, the more it hates: +1 a second at a post, +0.5 led, +2 hung or on a rack, +12 a lash, +3 searched.
Smoke from 30, angry sparks from 60.
When let go with 30 or more, it is chance: either it attacks whoever tied it for 30 seconds, or it runs faster for a minute (never faster than sprinting). The more resentful, the likelier the attack (a quarter at 30, three quarters at 100).
thief.guide.play.6.t:
Lead a tied thief to the bounty board and use it: lone 3 emeralds, crew 5, magician 10 and a badge; experience, the rope back, any loot left.
Use it with a badge in hand: 8 emeralds. Empty-handed: the rules.
thief.guide.play.7.t:
Two robbers and a lookout; now and then a magician too.
· The lookout whistles when you are within 24 blocks: the crew draws back 10 seconds.
· Chased, a robber gives all the loot to a mate and keeps shining as a decoy.
· Mates come to cut a captive loose; they run if you are within 7 blocks.
· They flee as fast as you walk (4.3 blocks/s); a lone thief is slower (3.3).
thief.guide.play.8.t:
10 to 20 seconds after a crew member is caught, a mate holds up a sign: let it go and 70% of the loot comes back. The offer stands 60 seconds, and nobody tries to rescue meanwhile.
To accept: let it go, empty-handed, not sneaking, anywhere.
No loot, no ransom; if the crew has stolen nothing yet it looks again every 5 seconds, for 5 minutes.
A lone thief caught may have help come later; stay within 7 blocks and it cannot.
thief.guide.play.9.t:
A crew of three or more has one 40% of the time. It does not steal; 40 health, a purple boss bar.
Within 24 blocks of you it makes copies every 20 seconds (up to 3, 10 seconds each), then swaps places with one. A copy turns to smoke on a touch; the real one is the one that hurts and has the bar.
The rope holds it only when it is worn down to a third of its health; hung or tied to a tree or rack it slips free sooner the longer it is there, but not in your hand.
thief.guide.play.10.t:
Only the magician disguises itself; ordinary thieves do not.
The magician carries two potions: about 1.5 seconds to drink, then it looks like an animal, a villager or a person-shaped creature (zombie, skeleton, pillager, witch...) within 24 blocks, for 60 seconds.
Reaching for a chest, throwing a card or smoke, a blow, a rope, or the potion wearing off, and it shows.
A tell: a blow makes the sound of a pillager; it does not wander like an animal.
thief.guide.play.11.t:
Zombies, husks, skeletons, villagers, pillagers, witches, piglins and the like can be tied too (never players); add or remove in bindableTypes.
Tied, their AI is off: no biting, no walking away; led, they jump up a block in the way.
Zombies, zombie villagers and skeletons tied in the sun still burn; those in helmets do not.
thief.guide.play.12.t:
{{/thief ledger}}  the record of thefts (everyone)
